content_sections.heading: Assam VFA Written Test Pattern
content_sections.text: Selection for the entry-level cadre of Veterinary Field Assistant (or its equivalent post) is through an OMR-based written test of 120 minutes duration, for 100 marks across 100 questions, set at Class 12 (HSSLC Science) standard. The test is HSSLC(Science)-level, multiple-choice (MCQ) format.

content_sections.heading: Mandatory One-Year Training
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must undergo a mandatory 1 (one) year Training in Elementary Knowledge of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Science at the School of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry, Assam, Ghungoor, Silchar, and its extended campuses under the Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Department. Candidates must pass this training before appointment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Assam VFA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: animalhusbandry.assam.gov.in . Register and fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and category details. Upload the required documents, including the Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC), educational certificates, and category/reservation certificates as applicable. Ex-Servicemen candidates applying against the reserved post must upload their Ex-Servicemen Identity Card (issued by the Zila Sainik Welfare Office, Assam) and Discharge Book. Review all details carefully and submit the application between 3 September 2026, 10:00 hrs and 23 September 2026, 23:59 hrs. No application fee is payable by any category of candidate.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: HSSLC (Class 12) Science stream mark sheet/certificate, with Biology as a subject HSLC Pass Certificate/HSLC Admit Card, or equivalent certificate from a recognized Board/Council, for age proof Valid Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC) issued in Assam, for proof of domicile Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC/MOBC candidates, issued by the competent authority in Assam PwBD certificate (Benchmark Disability 40% or more), issued by the competent authority, for candidates applying under the PwBD category Ex-Servicemen Identity Card (issued by the Zila Sainik Welfare Office, Assam) and Discharge Book, for Ex-Servicemen candidates applying against the reserved post

faq.question: Q1. How many VFA posts are available?
faq.answer: 200 posts of Veterinary Field Assistant and its allied cadre, under the Directorate of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary, Assam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
Q3. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: A pass in the full-time HSSLC (Class 12) examination in the Science stream with Biology as one of the subjects.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no application fee for any category of candidate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: 18 to 40 years as on 01-01-2026, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC/MOBC, 10 years for PwBD, and 2 years for Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A 100-mark OMR-based written test (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and General Awareness) of 120 minutes, at Class 12 standard.

faq.question: Q7. Is training required after selection?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates must complete and pass a mandatory 1-year training in Elementary Knowledge of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Science before appointment.
